info.title: VIRA Public API
info.description: Mobile app and seller web API (doc 07). Phase 2: identity, profiles, social graph, posts, feed, engagement, media, reports. Unsafe methods accept Idempotency-Key; money is integer Rial.

get.summary: Client configuration: non-regulated flags, regulated capabilities (always off), public remote config

post.summary: Send a 6-digit sign-in code by SMS (never reveals whether the number has an account)
Verify the code; signs in or creates the account; issues tokens
Rotate the refresh token (a reused token revokes the session); devices with a key send X-Vira-PoP

parameters.name: X-Vira-PoP
parameters.description: <unix seconds>.<base64url ECDSA P-256 signature of VIRA-REFRESH\n<ts>\n<refresh token>>

regulated_locked.description: Regulated capability → approval gate (FG-1b, G1, G2, G3)

phone.description: Iranian mobile; Persian/Arabic/ASCII digits, with or without +98 / 0

public_key.description: base64 SPKI of a P-256 key held by the device (proof of possession)

Consents.description: Explicit, unticked-by-default choices (doc 19 UC-5); all must be true

intends_to_sell.description: Account-type choice; seller onboarding is P4, same identity

avatar_url.description: API path of the avatar image

settings.description: Preferences of later-phase features (story_replies_from, mentions_from, messages_from, live_comments_from, allow_product_tags, show_activity, allow_reshare), stored now and enforced when each feature ships

avatar_media_id.description: uploaded image (purpose avatar); empty string removes

like_count.description: null when the author hides like counts
